sentences.text: What secrets hide beneath the emerald roof of the Amazon?
From high above, the rainforest reveals a continuous canopy of towering trees, draped with epiphytes and tangled lianas.
This green ceiling shelters between forty and seventy-five percent of the planet’s known species, and scientists believe millions more remain undiscovered.
Because many plants yield medicines, the forest has been called the world’s largest pharmacy, providing over a quarter of natural remedies.

The Amazon rainforest, spanning over 670 million hectares, is the largest terrestrial carbon sink, playing a crucial role in mitigating global warming by capturing up to 25% of global carbon dioxide emissions.

Yet the same canopy is under siege; slash-and-burn clearing during the dry season sparks fires that surged dramatically in 2019, with satellite data showing more than 80,000 fires across Brazil, a 77% rise, darkening skies as far away as São Paulo.
The canopy’s health therefore matters to the whole planet, acting as a buffer against global warming, and protecting it preserves countless species, medicines, and the climate we all share.
